info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Contact Center Operations Status API
info.description: The Contact Center Operations Status API provides real-time updates regarding the operational status of various banking channels. This endpoint allows consumers, such as customer service representatives and IT support teams, to retrieve the current status of contact center operations, ensuring better customer experience and timely responses. By monitoring these statuses, businesses can optimize their resources, address issues promptly, and enhance overall service delivery to customers. Use this API to gain insights into operational performance and support strategic decision-making.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of contact center operations for a specific channel.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to obtain the current operational status of the contact center associated with a specified channel. It provides insights into performance metrics and availability, helping businesses ensure efficient operations.

requestBody.description: This request body is utilized to retrieve the current status of contact center operations specific to a channel. It is essential for monitoring and managing the contact center's performance effectively.

200.description: The request was successful and the current status is returned.

_s_channel-specific_s_contact-center-ope.description: This schema represents the request body expected for the GET operation specific to status updates in contact center operations.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the response.
